caption:
Everyone says "neither were." Don't.

Neither means not either ONE. It takes a singular verb, even when a plural noun follows "of."

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: Everyone says neither were. It's neither was.

youtube.title: SAT Grammar: Neither Of Is Singular
youtube.description: Why neither of the proposals takes the verb it does on the SAT. SAT-style practice question (original).
